description: Template that asks an agent for an overdue status update

input-arguments.name: minutes
input-arguments.description: Minutes since the agent's last status update

input-arguments.name: status-update-command
input-arguments.description: Command the agent runs to post a status update of 34 characters or fewer

input-arguments.name: approve-command
input-arguments.description: Command the agent runs when it approves the final result
